description: First official provider-enabled ODG mission. A deliberately minimal engineering task whose sole purpose is to exercise the full Claude Provider Adapter route end-to-end. The Runtime decides on its own to call the provider — the mission declares an explicit write scope (authorizedPaths) and opts in with requiresEngineering, so missionRequiresProvider() returns true. The provider is invoked exactly once; an identical re-execution is served by the provider's existing on-disk cache with no live call. The provider never decides completion: only the Release Manager does.

objectives.goal: Create a single minimal marker file under the authorized path recording that the engineering provider executed this mission.
done_when: Exactly one file exists under src/app/provider-smoke/.
No file outside the authorized write scope is modified.

definition_of_done: Objective completed strictly within the authorized write scope.
